messages:
oliver: Hey team, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — fixes a batching edge-case and addresses the perf regression from last week. CI is failing on one test; can someone do a quick sanity-check on the test change and the fix? thanks.

jamal: taking a look now. can you add a one-line note in the PR description about how to reproduce the regression? that makes reviewing the benchmark delta easier.

oliver: good call — updated the PR description with repro steps, before/after numbers, and the perf run command.

ci-bot: ci/build — failed on `test_batch_rotation` (possible flake)

Log snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected seq len 64 != 63
  tests/test_batching.py:78
```

maya: i can reproduce the failing assertion locally. looks like an off-by-one in the padding logic when batch sizes align with the kv cache boundary. i'll push a tiny fix.

oliver: thank you — i'll hold off merging until CI passes. pushed branch `fix/pad-off-by-one`.

ci-bot: ci/build — success ✅ All checks passed (unit, integration, lint).

jamal: pulled and ran locally, tests look stable. one small nit: rename `pad_len` -> `padding_len` to be clearer. also add a short comment about why we adjust for the kv boundary. otherwise i'm +1.

oliver: done: renamed var, added the comment, removed a stray `print` i missed. pushed new commit.

lisa: :eyes: skimmed the change — looks safe. +1 for merging during the next canary window so infra tests exercise it.

jamal: agreed. canary window starts in ~20m; merge then so we can watch metrics.

oliver: will merge at 14:40 PST during the canary window. thanks everyone :rocket: 

(oliver pinned the PR link and added a short rollout note to the Redwood Console changelog)
